notes: MTS cutoffs are declared **state/UT-wise and session-wise**, separately for two age groups (18–25 and 18–27), so no single national number exists. Havaldar adds a PET/PST stage with its own state-wise shortlisting cutoffs. The rows below are **official minimum qualifying marks** plus representative final-stage figures from the MTS 2024 result — always check your own state's table in the official PDF. Marks are **normalized** across shifts.

qualifying.source: SSC MTS 2024 notification + final result write-up, ssc.gov.in
qualifying.note: Session 1 is qualifying-only; its marks do not count in the final merit, which comes from Session 2.

final.stage: Havaldar CBE → PET/PST shortlisting (representative state cutoffs)
final.source: Testbook compilation of official MTS 2024 Havaldar cutoffs (state-wise)
final.note: Illustrates how much state-wise Havaldar cutoffs swing; your state's row is in the official write-up. ~20,959 candidates were shortlisted for PET/PST in MTS 2024.

cutoffs.note: Declared per state/UT per age group per category in the official PDF

final.note: Too many state × age-group × category rows to reproduce here — the official PDF is canonical.
